name: hello-webapp
description: Single-page React app, the product's only surface: one public screen that shows the fixed greeting "Hello, World!" as its main heading. It needs no sign-in, calls no API and stores nothing. It also serves a GET /health path from the same web server that answers 200 with the plain text "ok", for liveness checks; it is not part of the visible UI. It does not offer navigation, personalisation or any other content.
